benchmark_claim: Primary matched tool-capability comparison on six frozen STRICT_CORE A2 projections. Extended typed and post-freeze recovered harnesses are reported separately. The frozen V0.11 certificates remain the source-level correctness evidence.

interpretation.bizproof: Frozen V0.11 symbolic result: correct adapter equivalent to the certified source slice and mutant disproved.
interpretation.crosshair: Assertion-based symbolic search on the same frozen projection. No reported counterexample is not credited as source-level proof.
interpretation.hypothesis: Counterexample search only. No counterexample within a budget is inconclusive.

nonmatched.reason: Harness pair was recovered after the original pre-execution selection freeze. Retained in the 17/17 A2 manifest but excluded from the primary strict-core benchmark.

selection_rule: Primary benchmark membership is restricted to the six candidates frozen in the STRICT_CORE protocol before baseline execution: standalone correct adapter and mutant, identical signatures, and only int/bool scalar inputs or zero inputs. No baseline outcome is used for selection.
